Results.ReviewText: Excellent grill and it looks good, too.  I like the built-in thermometer, too.
Results.Title: Copper Grill

ClientResponses.Response: Thank you for taking the time to share your feedback. We are sorry to learn that your experience was less than optimal. We will pass along your comments to the appropriate team. Please know a generous warranty backs your grill. If we can help with anything, be sure to contact us. Thank you!
ClientResponses.Name: Weber grills

Results.ReviewText: I have had five or six 22" kettles over the years and never had any issues. I recently bought one and immediately had problems getting ANY of legs into their tubes because all of the receiving tubes had welding debris or ridges inside (which were then enameled over.) I returned that grill and got a replacement, but it had the exact problem - once again in all three tubes. What has happened to Weber quality control?
Results.Title: It's time for Weber to get better QC people

Results.ReviewText: My kids knew I had been looking to purchase this grill and gave it to me as a gift.  I, along with my kids, have enjoyed ever piece of meat I have grilled and smoked with this grill.  It is easy and enjoyable to cook with and very well built.
Results.Title: A fun and enjoyable grill !!

Results.ReviewText: I love this grill. Holds temperature steady, easy ash clean out, solid construction. It’s a better grill than what I expected and I couldn’t be happier with it.
Results.Title: Great value and great product

Results.ReviewText: These grills last for many years.  This is my 3rd Webber grill.  The last one lasted for over 20 years.  The various colors make them a stand out in my neighborhood.  I prefer to use charcoal for my grilling.
Results.Title: Quality and durability

Results.ReviewText: I purchased this grill to use while waiting for parts for my smoker and I am glad I did. Its easy to use and works well.
Results.Title: Easy Assembly & works nicely!

Results.ReviewText: The best grills I have owned. Cooks very efficiently.
Results.Title: Replacement for 15 year old grill

Results.ReviewText: Best most versatile grill I ever owned. First time using charcoal will never use gas again well worth every penny
Results.Title: Great Grill

Results.ReviewText: I just smoked the best pulled pork I ever made on my Weber kettle grill! I am using this grill quit a bit. I also found a very used one that I brought back to life. I love these grills!
Results.Title: Very versatile, Very Happy!

Results.ReviewText: The Weber Premium 22” inch is my first grill. I’m new to grilling and this grill is truly a joy to use. The copper color and the design  is beautiful. My grilling experience is so smooth and fun thanks to this grill. It’s easy to clean and store away. I’ll use it for years to come. By the way It’s only been one month since purchasing this grill and I’ve bought another one! Thank you
Results.Title: What a awesome grill!

Results.ReviewText: I purchased a new Weber 22" Kettle Grill 4-5 years ago. The new grill never developed a good seal between the bowl and lid and the charcoal would burn out.  I eventually determined the leaking was do to the bowl and lid being warped and not meshing together, unlike my two older Weber grills which sealed tightly, resulting in saving charcoal.  Upon my request, Weber replaced the bowl and lid at no charge to me.  The new parts are flat and the fit is good.  Great customer support.
Results.Title: Great customer support

Results.ReviewText: I have had Weber Grills since the 80's at this point I have 4, still as good as ever. Love It!!!!
Results.Title: Weber products are worth the money!

Results.ReviewText: Perfect all around grill offering a vast amount of cooking options
Results.Title: Remarkably versatile

Results.ReviewText: I bought this so I could see experiment with charcoal. And I am really enjoying it. It is a great learning experience!!!
Results.Title: Nice!!!!

Results.ReviewText: Well designed and well made.  Smart features to maintain grill at optimum level so you will get consistent grilling results year after year.  I got the green one this time; these finishes are designed to protect the metal over the years.    This is my 4th Weber in 40 years of marriage. (Unfortunate car/grill accident in garage with wife driving led to early demise of 1st grill) I look forward to receiving cooking tips and recipes from Weber in coming years.
Results.Title: Long term quality product

Results.ReviewText: Has an incredible number of features over the standard kettle.
Results.Title: Rich in features to make BBQ easier.

Results.ReviewText: This Weber grill is great for a variety of meats and vegetables
Results.Title: Weber 22” kettle grill

Results.ReviewText: Great grill! My only issue was the leg assembly. It’s a little difficult to make the legs properly lock in. I was able to get 2/3 legs secured and it works fine.
Results.Title: Great grill!

Results.ReviewText: After years of gas BBQ grilling, I wanted charcoal grilled burgers. So, I bought a Weber Original premium grill. It works very well for me. I like how you can shut off the air vents when finished cooking and the charcoal goes out and you can relight it next time. I also like using a chimney to light the charcoal. I'm happy with my new BBQ.
Results.Title: Back to Charcoal

Results.ReviewText: An Excellent Grill for cooking Steaks, Fish, Veggies ect.... Haven't tried a long cooking yet, I pretty much use my Offset for Ribs Pork or Beef, Brisket and Pork Butts. But for quick things for supper or cookouts on the weekend You can't beat a Weber. I have been using a Weber for many years and decided to upgrade.
Results.Title: Original Kettle Premium Charcoal Grill 22".

Results.ReviewText: I love the flavor charcoal lends to food when cooked on a grill, and Weber makes the very best charcoal grill in my estimation. I have owned a kettle grill for more than 40 years. The first one was a Montgomery Ward imitation of a Weber. It lasted about ten years. When it gave out, I knew I wanted the real thing. That Weber lasted almost 30 years before the lid handle rusted off. The only way to replace it was with another Weber, which I have done. And because Weber doesn't change things just to change the, my accessories still fit. I have a set of charcoal rails, a side table and the lovely rotisserie, and they all work with my new grill just as they did with the old one, Hurrah for Weber!
Results.Title: The best

Results.ReviewText: Really great grill so far, you can offset smoke on it and grill burgers. I would def get a chimney to start coals!!
Results.Title: General review

Photos.Caption: Big enough for a snake, hickory chunks and a large drip pan.

Results.ReviewText: A girl can’t get enough grilling! I have BBQ’d steak, whole chickens, skewers and even smoked a brisket in this grill. I am impressed by the flavor I get from the wood and briquettes. My husband thinks I should enter contests because my BBQ and grilling tastes so good. It is just so simple and easy to make flavorful and delicious meals on I use it 3x per week.  I love the green kettle.  Super cute.
Results.Title: Love my kettle grill!

Results.ReviewText: Great engineering.  Everything you need and nothing you don't.
Results.Title: Great engineering

Results.ReviewText: I'm a first time griller late in life, but with a little online research (including the Weber recipes), I've served up delicious steaks and pork chops, along with burgers and dogs.  It was well-packed and easy to put together, and I was up and running in no time.
Results.Title: Love this grill.

Results.ReviewText: Great for indirect grilling. The deep round shape helps create a sort of convection allowing the smoke to penetrate all side.perfectly.
Results.Title: Simply the BEST

Results.ReviewText: I moved to Weber after owning a Competing product  for a number of years. I absolutely love that the air vents in the bottom clean the ash out of the kettle. I’m certainly seals tighter for better heat control, more smoke flavour on the food and being able to close it off and save fuel for the next cook. The ash catcher is efficient and no sparks or flankers escape which is a nice piece of mind on a wooden patio. The grill is heavy and durable compared to competitors. I enjoy the lid holder hook as well and built in utensil hanging points in the handle.
Results.Title: Love my Weber

Results.ReviewText: The Weber Grill just keeps getting better and better.  I recently moved over 1,000 miles so reluctantly had to bid farewell to my Weber Grill I'd had for the last 17 years.  Aside from replacing the grates it was zero maintenance.  In that time I threw out two portable gas grills used for tail gate parties.  Now I have a copper colored grill with an included temperature gage.  Better than ever.
Results.Title: The Weber Grill is better than ever.

ClientResponses.Response: Hi! Thank you for being a long time Weber fan! We greatly appreciate you taking the time to provide your feedback regarding the lid holder. It is unfortunate to hear you are not satisfied with the hook inside the lid. We have reached out via email to offer a solution. We look forward to working with you to get this resolved. Thank you!
ClientResponses.Name: Weber Grills

Results.ReviewText: The grill top is difficult to use.  When you need to cook with the cover it is very difficult to find the hook to hang the top.  Still love  the charcoal flavor from this grill.
Results.Title: Weber 22” Grill top

Results.ReviewText: Great grill.  This is a big improvement of my basic 22" Kettle Grill.
Results.Title: A Step Up.

Results.ReviewText: I just gave top billing to the Kettle Grill 22", when rating the Smokey Mountain Cooker and Smoker.  The kettle was my first purchase in early Summer, on sale at Lowe's.  Right off, I smoked a pork butt and some incredibly good pork ribs, and was hooked.  Follow-up cooks saw the demand by the family turn my thoughts to a second cooker, so as to be able to smoke/cook in tandem.  So, this 22" Kettle grill opened up a whole world of possibilities.
Results.Title: Intro to Smoking with the Kettle Premium 22"

Results.ReviewText: After using this grill We have gone back to charcoal after many years of propane.
Results.Title: Done with pro pain grilling

Results.ReviewText: Buy this grill if you don’t want to deal with the messy ashes. I’ve used Weber products my entire life, these grills last for many many years, and offer nearly the same cooking experience as pricier ceramic grills. These grills also look fantastic on a patio
Results.Title: Dependable. Looks great!

Results.ReviewText: Good quality build and makes amazing bbq, Ive had weber grills previously, they last forever , my last one lasted me more than 15 years
Results.Title: Good quality, will never compromise, Weber only

Results.ReviewText: Had a top issue, was immediately replaced. Cooks like a champ
Results.Title: Excellent

Results.ReviewText: I can’t say enough! If you want to grill like a pro this is it. I switched from propane and will never go back. Get yourself the chimney, fire it up and get it hot. It takes about 60mins for me so i just budget that into my time. It also keeps temp for at least 90mins without adding coals so it’s very time flexible. I just started making pizza with a stone on the grates. :-)
Results.Title: Weber 22” kettle is awesome!

Results.ReviewText:
I have owned Weber Kettle products for several years and I can attest to the quality of the product as well as the excellence in customer service. 

The design of the Weber kettle offers the options of cooking in multiple ways. Weber has made minor changes to their kettles since the beginning of the kettle deign, but maintains the core of what they are about.
Results.Title: Very versatile

Results.ReviewText: This is a great grill. The ease of assembly made for a great start. Spending a little extra for this model was worth the investment.
Results.Title: Kettle Grill

Results.ReviewText: 1st time Kettle owner, long time charcoal enthusiast. This does it all. I just put a thermometer at grate level and now i smoke meats as well.
Results.Title: Brisket Smoking Machine

Results.ReviewText: Charcoal is the best. Holds temp extremely well.  Weber grills last the longest
Results.Title: Charcoal Weber 22 grill

Results.ReviewText: Easy to use. Cooks great. A very pleasant cooking experience. Obviously a quality product.
Results.Title: I love my Weber Kettle

Results.OriginalProductName: Barbecue au charbon Original Kettle Premium 22 po
Results.ReviewText:
4 fois on l'essaie et on est deja content
Gout super bon
Results.Title: Un gout saboureux

Results.ReviewText: Great a grill!  Easy to use even for a newbie like myself.  I did a cook out with vegetables, chicken, hot dogs and burgers.  Everything went well.  I can't wait to use it again.  It was a little challenging assembling the legs.  I used the app that had 3D pictures, which helped but slide the legs into the grill was not easy.  Even after I put a couple of them in correctly they ended up moving around.  The wheels while a nice touch don't feel sturdy and I one of them slipped off even though I pushed it in all the way.
Results.Title: Great grill but bring elbow grease for assembly

Results.ReviewText: I’ve always been a big fan of the Weber products so when needing a new grill for travels in our camper why choose anything else!! Quality is key and that’s what Weber Grill are all about.
Results.Title: Choose The Best!!

Results.ReviewText: I can smoke with it.  My 18-inch one only gave me 5 hours, this one with the ash collector, gives me as many hours as I need.  Have been up to 12 hours.
Results.Title: Smokin’

Results.ReviewText: It looks like a basic grill but it’s a flame thrower. We love it it’s just not the slow cooker we owned for 20 years.  Learning new skills in grilling.
Results.Title: Grilling

14401001.Name: 22” Original Kettle® Premium Charcoal Grill
14401001.Description: Some things never go out of style—like the smoky flavor of charcoal, the sizzle of a summer cookout, and the iconic silhouette of the 22" Original Kettle® Premium Charcoal Grill. This grill features a built-in lid thermometer to monitor the temperature inside the grill, and a hinged, plated-steel cooking grate flips up on either side allowing you to easily add more fuel while cooking. Like all Weber® kettles, it’s built to last with a porcelain-enameled bowl and lid that retains heat and resist rust, peeling, and scratching, and adjustable lid and bowl dampers to fine-tune the heat for perfect results. When it’s time to clean up, the One-Touch™ cleaning system makes it neat and effortless—just swipe the lever to clear ashes into the enclosed, high-capacity ash catcher. Two wheels make it easy to roll this timeless classic to the center of the action, right where it belongs. Because some grills don’t just cook food, they make memories.· Porcelain-enameled finish is scratch and rust-resistant· Room to cook for 6-8 people· Hinged, plated-steel cooking grate· Lid thermometer makes it easy to see grill temperature· Adjustable lid and bowl dampers let you control temperature· Lid hook to hang lid on bowl while cooking· 2 tool hooks included on bowl handle· One-Touch™ cleaning system sweeps ash into enclosed catcher· Easy to move on two durable, all-weather wheels· Heat-resistant lid and bowl handles· Bottom, wire storage shelf· Durable fuel grate· 3 aluminum legs are rust-resistant· 10-year limited warranty
